scope: Synthetic contracts for independent reruns of the targeted-input and payment-cap repair
old_evidence_rationale: The human contract allowed at most CNY 1,000 per voluntary transaction and only partial prepayment. The old UI had no cap or full-settlement field. Its handling is preserved unchanged.
patch_rationale: For the separately stated, known synthetic contract with a per-action cap only, explicitly confirm there is no periodic cap. This permits the positive CNY 1,000 control. A legacy contract without that assertion is separately tested as unknown.
synthetic_asset_and_counts_note: The script explicitly specifies each tested household, asset value, protection and scenario target. These are laboratory cash-flow cases, without observed family or macro calibration.
